reason: Example of the first question list for the question migration. Replace the entries with the questions the operator wants on the frontier at migration; the entries below only show the format and the grain of a question.

questions.statement: What does the distribution look like in the regime where the relative margin is of order k^(-1/3), and which structural feature of the parking process produces that scale?
questions.grounds: Several published records, using different methods, lose their margin at the same relative scale. No record explains why that scale appears; each measures where its method stops. An answer would show whether the stalls share one cause. Conjectural: the scale may come from a common fluctuation mechanism.

questions.statement: Why do the moment, transfer and direct-counting methods stall at the same place, and what property of the object do they all fail to see there?
questions.grounds: The frontier's records on the left and right regimes each stop at a comparable boundary. The common block is measured but not understood; understanding it would say what kind of argument could pass it.
